assertions.description: Output references the correct Coolify deployment flow (git push -> CI -> Coolify API -> Docker -> Traefik)
Output references Dockerfile or Docker build when discussing deployment
Output does NOT suggest using npm, yarn, or pnpm (bun-only project)
Output does NOT suggest yarn (bun-only project)
Output references Clerk DNS CNAMEs when SSL or auth cert issues arise
Output references Traefik for routing and SSL
Output references health checks or health probes for container readiness
Output references the VPS server details (IP, SSH, or linuxuser)
Output length is under 700 words for focused responses
Output warns about updating Dockerfile COPY, tsconfig.json, vitest.config.ts, and bun.lock when deleting a workspace package
